# Vendored dependencies

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified SheetJS Community Edition package, under Apache-2.0 (the package includes its license).

- Source: <https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz>
- Installation guidance: <https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/frameworks/>
- SHA-256: `8dc73fc3b00203e72d176e85b50938627c7b086e607c682e8d3c22c02bb99fe8`

The web workspace uses this local tarball. No spreadsheet library is loaded from a CDN at runtime. Update the version, package reference, checksum and lockfile together when upgrading.
